title: Chapter 6261: Who Is Going To Kill Me?
content:
Chapter 6261: Who Is Going To Kill Me?

Chapter 6261: Who Is Going To Kill Me?

By forcing Bronze-blade and Coldblade to leave the area, it was no different from severing their dao comprehension.

"It's unreasonable." A cultivator whispered.

"Well, not quite. The competition can be ruthless at times." An ancestor said.

"It doesn't have to be personal." A big shot added.

"Yes, it's just about the worldly energy for a better dao fruit. Moreover, this happens all the time without any personal vendetta. A stronger cultivator, out of annoyance, might interfere and stop the dao comprehension. This is why dao protectors are necessary." Another ancestor said.

"Another reason why it's better to be a desolate god. The ascension doesn't draw this much unwanted attention." An expert said.

"You too are pushing it." Bronze-blade was furious despite his mild temperament. He was only one step away and this could ruin it all.

"If you don't leave, we will seize your fortune and dao fruit. Be wise and leave, save some face." Crimson Cauldron spoke.

"Do they have emperors as dao protectors too? Otherwise, it will be a defeat or even death." An ancient ancestor said.

"It might be over for Bronze-blade Ancestor since his clan has no emperor, he's already the strongest." His friend said.

Everyone understood background mattered the most at this moment.

"Skyraiser Dynasty, God Frontier won't let this transgression go unpunished." Coldblade didn't yield.

"I'm afraid your God Frontier won't be able to save you this time, we have a primal ancestor." Frost uttered coldly before glancing upward.

Others saw an active portal with boundless divinity on the other side. No one knew who was beyond but given the power oozing from it, it must be a primal ancestor.

"Seventy-two Origin Ancestor, or Skyraiser Ancestor?" Someone looked up in reverence.

"Could be Trinity himself..." A big shot shuddered after thinking about this.

"Trinity in person..." An ancestor turned pale upon hearing this title.

"That's why they called for help, to get primal ancestors involved." The crowd became nervous.

Primal ancestors' arrival would be incredible, especially the legendary Trinity.

"Bronze-blade and Coldblade must give up." A crowd member sighed.

"This is outrageous, they're almost there already." A youth said indignantly.

"It's the imperial path, there are always dangers from all sides. It's not unprecedented." His ancient ancestor said.

"I will make it a pyrrhic victory for you." Bronze-blade couldn't give up when the dao fruit was so close to formation. This applied to Coldblade as well.

"It won't happen, we will seize your fortune and dao fruit." Crimson Cauldron shook his head.

Others saw a gruesome vision - two pseudo-emperors having their dao fruits taken before death.

"Barbaric acts still occur in a nice place like Three Immortals. How disappointing to see emperors such as you two. Why does it matter whether one proves their dao earlier or later?" A distant voice could be heard.

Everyone looked back and saw a group led by a youth - Li Qiye.

"This guy again." Someone said.

Crimson Cauldron and Frost immediately scanned Li Qiye and found nothing peculiar. They frowned at the strange result.

"Who may you be?" Crimson Cauldron asked, feeling perplexed since this mortal didn't fear them.

"A noisy passerby unable to witness this injustice." Li Qiye smiled: "You two soured the atmosphere of Three Immortals with your unsavory choices."

"Your disrespect warrants death." Frost said.

"Who is going to kill me? You?" Li Qiye said with disdain.

Frost's imperial aura immediately surged toward Li Qiye. She viewed him as nothing more than an insect.

It froze everything along the way. This ice affinity was dangerous and virtually undispellable.

The young ones immediately hid behind Li Qiye who easily stopped it.

"I see, a bit capable." Frost spoke: "I will kill you first."

"I wanted to spare the two of you but didn't expect such stupidity. So be it, how do you want to die?" Li Qiye stunned the crowd with his comment.

"Does he know who he is facing?" A big shot murmured.

"Fellow Daoist, you think rather highly of yourself, but we aren't insects." Crimson Cauldron said.

"No difference in my eyes." Li Qiye said.

The two emperors couldn't believe their ears. This was their first time being insulted and viewed as insects.

"Is he tired of living? Just who is he?" A crowd member said.

"You will suffer for this, it will not be a swift death." Frost's eyes gleamed murderously.
